Commentary.Commentary: 146 to win for Ireland to stay alive in this competition. India might have put up an under-par total but on a sluggish track, with a decent bowling attack and not so attacking batters from the opposition, that might prove to be more than enough. The run chase will begin soon...

Smriti Mandhana is up for a chat with Mel Jones. She says that the score is definitely under-par and is disappointed with the way India have batted. Adds that they were looking at somewhere around 160-170 but now hopes to bowl and field well. Admits that the wicket was a bit damp, so the batters had to wait for the ball to come before playing their shots. Stresses that they played according to the merit of the ball. Is pumped up on the prospect of playing her first ever WT20 semi-final but wants to win today and then play Australia before thinking too far ahead.

A bit of indiscipline from the Irish bowlers. When the ball was doing a bit, they did not do their bit, spraying tit all around and allowing India to accumulate runs. They missed plenty of chances, making life difficult for themselves. But then, when the period was the toughest, they bounced back, conceding just 36/4 in the last 5 overs. Kim Garth was the pick of the bowlers, with 2/22 in her 4 overs while Eimear Richardson's 1/27 kept India honest.

The Indian batters came out one after another and tried to hit the ball too hard and in the process, started throwing their wickets away. Mithali Raj held one end up and ensured that it was not too bad a collapse, getting consecutive half centuries. Had she not been there, it would have been very difficult for the Indians.

Ummm... it is a good score on a slow track but given the way India were playing, they will feel they are 15-20 runs short. The openers set it up with a fine 67-run stand and that was followed with a 49-run partnership for the second wicket between Mithali and Rodrigues. But the latter's dismissal just turned it around.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a run. INDIA FINISH ON 145/6!
Full and down the leg side, clipped over mid-wicket for a single.
Radha Yadav comes in at number 8, replacing Hemalatha.

OUT! A run out now. Hemalatha's pace and Deepti's slowness has cost India a wicket. Full and outside off, Sharma miscues her slash and it goes high in the air. Just about eludes Kim Garth at cover. The batters take a single but even before Deepti can get to the other end, Hemalatha has already turned blind for the second. Deepti now sees Garth pick up the ball and puts her hand up but Dayalan is already halfway down. Joyce throws it to the keeper who takes the bails off. Hemalatha does not even bother going back.
Similar ball, this time Deepti connects with her slash, getting it to sweeper cover. She is happy with the single but Hemalatha pushes her into the second.
Full and outside off, Deepti slashes but misses.
Outside leg, chipped through mid-wicket for a couple.
Full and wide outside off, Hemalatha reaches out to drive but misses out.
Another yorker, nicely dug out to the off side for a single.
FOUR! Short, slower in pace, pulled through mid-wicket for a boundary!
Deepti Sharma comes in at number 7, replacing Mithali.

OUT! Caught behind! Another slower ball, full and wide outside off, Raj reaches out to drive but only gets a thick outside edge to the keeper. End of a wonderful and important innings. She has actually held forte. The rest have fallen around her.
Comes down the track, gets a high full toss but mistimes it to long off. A run taken.
On middle and leg, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Kim Garth returns.
On middle and leg, flicked through the leg side for a couple.
Full and around off, Hemalatha looks to defend but gets a thick inside edge onto her pads.

17TH T20I FIFTY FOR MITHALI! Consecutive ones for Raj. What a great asset she is to the Indian side. No celebration from her, in fact, she does not even realize till Hemalatha runs across and congratulates her. Full and around off, coming in, Mithali looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. Seems to be an inside edge. Takes the run.
Full and wide outside off, driven through cover-point where the fielder dives to her right to keep the batters to a single.
Dayalan Hemalatha is the new batter at number 6, replacing Veda.

OUT! BOWLED! Lock, stock and barrel. What a crushing yorker. Right on middle, Krishnamurthy walks down the track and looks to initially flick, then tries to jam her bat down. Too late. That is as good yorker one will ever see. Hits the stumps.
A short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for a couple.
Lucy O'Reilly is back on.
Punches this through the covers for a single.
Full and around off, driven straight back to the bowler.
FOUR! Full and around off, Veda gets down and swings it over mid-wicket for a boundary!
Outside off, Veda looks to cut but misses.
Around off, pushed through long on for a run.
Full and around off, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
A long hop, pulled through mid-wicket for one. 9 runs and a wicket from the over, Richardson finishes with figures of 4-0-27-1 so far.
Full and outside off, driven straight to short extra cover.
Short, down the leg side, pulled through fine leg for a single.
Veda Krishnamurthy comes in at number 5, replacing Kaur.

OUT! Brilliantly caught! That is a big wicket. Once again Harmanpreet comes down the track and this time, the bowler bowls a high full toss. The skipper smashes it but Shauna Kavanagh moves swiftly to her right at sweeper cover and takes the catch!
SIX! SMASH! No time wasting by Harmanpreet here. Full and outside off, Kaur comes down the track and lofts it miles over long on!

Gosh. That looked dead plumb. But the LBW appeal has not been given and Ireland do not bother reviewing it. Full and around off, Raj walks across and looks to sweep but misses. She is hit flush on the pads and Ireland appeal but the umpire moves away. Leg bye signalled on the run taken.
Eimear Richardson to bowl out. 3-0-19-0 so far.
Outside off, eased through point for a run. 7 runs but a wicket as well from the over.

MIX-UP, BUT SAFE! Kaur had come a long way down. Outside off, Mithali got a long way across and tucked it towards short fine leg. She took a couple of steps and on seeing that, Hrmanpreet started to run. She was halfway down the track but then Mithali changed her mind. The skipper had to get back, she dived inside the crease but the throw missed the stumps.
Off the mark straightaway. Around off, placed through point for a single.
Captain Harmanpreet Kaur walks in next, at number 4, replacing Rodrigues.

OUT! STUMPED! It is a wide ball but you can get stumped off a wide ball. Rodrigues gives the early signal that she is coming down the track. Seeing that, Delany bowls it shorter and wider outside off. Jemimah tries to drag it to the leg side but misses. Easy stumping for Mary Waldron.
Very wide outside off, but Mithali goes after it, stroking it towards cover for a run.
Around off, pushed wide of long on for a couple.
Full and around off, slogged through mid on for a single.
Outside off, pushed through mid off for one.

FOUR! Terrific batting. Full and straight, would have clattered the stumps had Rodrigues missed. But she doesn't. Gets across, goes low on a knee and slogs it over short fine leg for a boundary! 100 UP FOR INDIA! Around 6 overs left... Is 175 on the cards? This stand is worth 34 from 23 balls.
Full and outside off, Raj reaches out and lofts it towards sweeper cover for a run.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Action replay of the previous delivery.
On middle, pushed towards long on for a single.
Maritz returns.

FOUR! Delightful shot. Landed outside off, Rodrigues waits for the ball to come to her and dabs it late past short third man! Interesting stat - Out of the 13 overs bowled, Ireland have conceded a boundary on the last ball in 6 occasions - 4 fours and 2 sixes! Just spoils the effort in the entire over...
Full and around off, slogged towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Full on middle, pushed towards long on for a single.
A full toss, swept straight to square leg.
Miles outside off, Rodrigues gets a long way across and looks to cut but misses.

TOP EDGE, NOT TAKEN! The fielding has not been of the greatest quality from Ireland. Full and around off, Raj gets down to sweep but gets a top edge. The ball goes high in the air and Kim Garth at square leg has plenty of time to take that. However, she misjudges it so badly, that even after going behind for just 3 steps, she does not even get to the ball and it drops behind her! A single taken.
The skipper brings herself on. Laura Delany to bowl.
FOUR! MARVELLOUS! 14 from the over! Full and wide outside off, Rodrigues reaches out and drives it behind point for a boundary! The stand moves to 20 from 12 balls.
Pushes this through mid on for one more.
FIVE WIDES! Full and down the leg side, Raj misses her flick while the keeper behind cannot get there even with a dive to her left. Ordinary bowling.
Dropped short, MR looks to pull but gets a bottom edge.
Another full toss, around off, flicked through mid-wicket for another couple.

TOP EDGE, SAFE! A slower ball, around off, Mithali looks to slog but the ball sticks on the surface. She is early into the shot and gets a top edge. Luckily for her, the ball does not carry to the fielder running in. Two more runs taken.
A full toss on middle, Raj misses out. Whips it straight to short fine leg. A meter either side would have been a boundary.
Lucy O'Reilly is back on. 1-0-5-0 so far.
On middle and off, worked through mid-wicket for one.
WIDE. Full and miles outside off, Mithali lets it go.
Pushes this through long on for another single.
Outside off, eased through the covers for one more.
Full and around off, pushed through mid on for a run.
Fuller in length, a bit straighter, pushed through mid off for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Jemimah Rodrigues comes in at number 3, replacing Mandhana.

OUT! BOWLED! Ireland finally get a breakthrough. Change of pace eventually does the trick. A slower ball, pitched on a length around middle, bowled at 96 kph, Mandhan goes for a slog. But the shot was played in June while the month going on is November. She misses and the ball hits the timber. 3-0-15-1 so far for Garth. Decent opening stand for India, worth 67 while Mandhana will not mind the outing that she got.
Comes down the track, does Mandhana, has a hack but the ball barely bounces. Goes off the inner half towards short mid-wicket.
Pushes this through mid on and gets a single.
Much better from Garth. Gets it around the fourth stump line, keeps the length a touch shorter, Raj defends it towards mid on.

FOUR! Excellent batting. Change of pace from Garth and Mithali is ready. Goes back, waits for the ball to come to her and deftly opens the bat-face to guide it past short third man. Moves to 30 from 30 balls with her 4th four.

Lovely shot. Hits the ball on the rise and finds the gap too. That came right out of the middle of the bat and we thought, FOUR RUNS. But the fielder has been placed perfectly. Also, the wet weather means that the outfield has slowed down considerably. A length ball outside off, Mandhana comes down the track and lofts it inside out over cover, but straight to sweeper. Just a single.
Around off, solidly defended towards mid off.
Full toss around middle, Mandhana comes down the track and flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for another single.
On middle and off, flicked through mid-wicket for one more. The stand moves to 60 from 52 balls.
Landed outside off, dabbed past short third man for one.
Around off, going away, Raj audaciously walks across her stumps and pulls her through mid-wicket for a run.
A short ball outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
Isobel Joyce comes into the attack now.

FOUR! Finally Raj gets it right! That releases all the pressure, if ever there was any. Landed outside off, Mithali waits for he ball to come to her this time. The line is not bad but probably the length is a bit too short. That gives the batter some extra time as she opens the face of the bat and guides it past short third man for a boundary!
Full and around off, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.

Another lovely delivery, probably a touch wide but it draws the shot from Raj. She reaches out to play the same shot as the previous one, opening the face of the bat and guiding it towards third man but there is no feet movement and she cannot connect.
Runs her fingers around the left side of the ball, which means it holds on the surface. Mithali tries to run it down to third man but misses because of the lack of pace.
Outside off, punched through the covers for a run.
Outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
Kim Garth is back on.

SIX! Magnificent hit! Once again Mandhana uses her feet. Comes down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts it straight down the ground! 50-RUN STAND IS UP! That is a good recovery after a sedate start.
Dropped short, pulled straight to short fine leg.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Short and outside off, third on the trot, punched through the covers for a run.
Short ball again, pulled once more for a single.
Short and down the leg side, stays low, Mandhana pulls it towards short fine leg.
Celeste Raack introduced.
FOUR! Poor bowling. What a finish to the Powerplay for India. Full and down the leg side, Raj flicks it past short fine leg! 15 from this over, 26 off the last 2 and India ends the Powerplay on 42/0!
FOUR! Beautiful shot. Full and outside off, Raj leans and drives it through the covers for a boundary!
WIDE! Bowls way down the leg side, Mithali lets it go.
Outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Outside off, steered through third man for a single.
FOUR! Terrific shot. Full and on middle, Mandhana comes down the track and swings it over mid-wicket for a boundary!
Nothing on the Free Hit. Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
NO BALL! Starts off by overstepping. Bowls it outside off, a touch fuller, Mandhana opens the face of the bat and guide but misses. FREE HIT COMING UP.
Lara Maritz is introduced. Can she make amends for the dropped catch?
SIX! Ho ho! What a shot! Tremendous shot. Tossed up on middle stump, Mithali dances down the track and hits it over long off for a biggie! 11 off that over, India pressing on the accelerator.
A short ball again, pulled straight to mid-wicket.
Outside off, spinning in, staying low, Raj somehow manages to push it towards cover.
Full and outside off, Smriti comes down the track and pushes it towards long off for a single.
Flighted delivery on off stump, Mandhana tries to cut but gets a bottom edge on that one.
FOUR! There she goes! Just second nature, isn't it? Beautiful shot. Tossed up on off stump, Mandhana dances down the track and plays it over covers for a boundary.
Length delivery on middle stump, Mithali plays it towards mid-wicket.
Length delivery on middle stump, Mithali defends off the front foot.
Length delivery on off stump, Mandhana plays it towards square leg. They take a single.
On middle, pushed down the ground for a single.
That has surprised Mithali again! A short ball around off, Raj looks to pull but suddenly the ball shoots up. She somehow fends it to the leg side.
Full on off stump, Mandhana drives it towards covers. They take a single.
Kim Garth to bowl now.
Works it towards short mid-wicket.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.

DROPPED! Oh dear... This is short and around off, Mithali looks to pull but this one barely bounces. She mistimes it towards square leg where Lara Maritz is stationed but she puts it down! Straight in, straight out.
TURN! Plenty of it. Just keeping everyone interested. Turn and bounce,  Mithali got hit on the pads. She wanted to push towards the leg side.
Tossed up on off stump, Mandhana guides it to point. They take a single.
Full and outside off, Raj comes down the track and pushes it towards long on for a single.
Bowls full on middle stump, Mandhana plays it towards mid on.
Outside off, pushed straight to cover.
A touch short, outside off, Smriti goes back to cut but gets a bottom edge.
A full toss now, pushed towards mid off.

FOUR! Great shot by Mandhana. Short and wide outside off stump, Mandhana cuts it towards third man for a boundary. The fielder at short third man puts in a slide to her left but the ball goes through!
Bowls wide outside off stump, Raj plays it towards point. They take a single.
Seam from the other end. Lucy O'Reilly to bowl from the other end.
FOUR! First boundary of the day! Short and down the leg side, Mandhana goes back and pulls it through square leg!
Flighted delivery on off stump, Mandhana defends off the front foot.
Tossed up again on middle stump, Mithali comes forward and hits it towards mid on. They take a single.
WIDE! Bowls way down the leg side, Mithali lets it go. India are underway.
Stays back to this one and punches it towards cover.
Full and outside off, Mithali comes down the track and looks to defend but gets hit on the pads.
Tossed up on middle stump, Mithali gets it off her pads.

A big round of applause goes around the ground as the ground staff walks off the field. Great work from them to get this game starting on time. The Irish players get into a huddle. Out come the Indian openers now - Smriti Mandhana and Mithali Raj. It will be spin to start off proceedings. Eimear Richardson will bowl to Mithali, with a slip in place. Here we go!

The national anthems are done and dusted and the great news is that the RAIN HAS STOPPED. The cover is also off and we should not be having too much of a delay. Plenty of blue in the sky overhead as well, so the conditions seem to be improving, though there is a big naughty grey cloud threatening to burst.

Bizarre. Really bizarre. There is a heavy drizzle and the PITCH IS COVERED. But the players are out with the national anthems. Seems to be a bit tough on the players. Anyways, the Irish anthem will be played first.

Indian skipper, Harmanpreet Kaur, says that she was also looking to bowl first but toss is not in her hand and the team is prepared for anything. Says that the team had 2 days off and everyone is fresh. Informs that the unit is going with one change today - Mansi Joshi comes in for Arundathi Reddy.

Irish captain, Laura Delany, says that there is a bit of rain around so chasing would be the best option. On the preparations, the skipper says that they will be looking to achieve small targets. Informs that Ciara Metcalfe has got some medical issues and hence misses out. Lara Maritz replaces her.
TOSS - We have a delayed toss but the start will be on time. Great. The 'home' captain is Harmanpreet Kaur. HEADS is the call from Delany and HEADS it is.  IRELAND OPT TO CHASE.
PITCH REPORT - After all the rain, there are a few dark spots on the outfield. But otherwise, the ground seems to be pretty dry.

WEATHER REPORT - Different conditions today has heavy clouds are lurking around the stadium. We had a heavy downpour at around 7 am local time, but the ground staff has done a tremendous job with a start expected on time. Just as we started to speak, it has started to drizzle. India will not mind but Ireland need this match to get completed. A washout will anyways eliminate them. Fingers crossed, that we get a full game tonight!

Till now the pitches have played well going into the tournament. However in day games, chasing seems to be the key with the tracks tending to get slower during the night. How will it play today? Hopefully we get a good contest.

On the other hand, Ireland have lost both their matches which they have played. The Irish batters need to step up and put a strong performance today. Their batting has not clicked as a unit. Today's match is going to be a must-win game for them. India have got a good bowling attack while their batting has also clicked so far. Smriti Mandhana's form is a big concern for India though. The opener needs to fire today to get a bit of confidence going ahead in the tournament.

Hello and welcome to Match 13 of the Women's World T20 between India and Ireland. The match is being held at Guyana. India Women's team are in a strong position by winning two out of two. If they win today's match they will join Australia in the semifinals.
